claims.text: Guided Evolution (GE) utilizes Large Language Models to directly modify code during evolutionary model development.
The Evolution of Thought (EoT) technique enables LLMs to reflect on and learn from the outcomes of previous mutations.
Guided Evolution maintains genetic diversity by modulating LLM model temperature and utilizing crafted prompts.
Applying Guided Evolution to ExquisiteNetV2 increased model accuracy from 92.52% to 93.34% without compromising model compactness.

evidence.description: Guided Evolution (GE) diverges from traditional methods by utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) to directly modify code.
Evolution of Thought (EoT) technique enables LLMs to reflect on and learn from the outcomes of previous mutations, resulting in a self-sustaining feedback loop.
GE maintains genetic diversity by leveraging LLMs' capability to generate diverse responses from expertly crafted prompts and modulate model temperature.
The LLM-driven GE autonomously produced ExquisiteNetV2 variants with improved accuracy from 92.52% to 93.34%, without compromising model compactness.

methodologies.name: Guided Evolution (GE)
methodologies.description: An evolutionary framework that leverages LLMs and reflective reasoning (Evolution of Thought) to directly modify code, guide mutations, and maintain genetic diversity.

limitations.text: Traditional AutoML approaches rely on abstraction layers such as tree-based or Cartesian genetic programming.
